identitySignals: Alameda Health System is headquartered in Oakland, CA (1411 East 31st Street), matching OUSD's Oakland location (alamedahealthsystem.org contact page)
AHS's own site says its health internship program is open to students who attend an Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) public or charter school, showing a direct working link with OUSD

AHS is a public health care system that runs hospitals and wellness centers, consistent with OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' MOU with the Community Schools and Student Services Department
research.notes: Public hospital authority, not a nonprofit, so no EIN is listed (the separate Alameda Health System Foundation has its own EIN and is a different entity). The official site fails TLS verification in WebFetch but loads with curl. The 510-437-4800 number is labeled General Inquiries and Operator Assistance. No general email found. California Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked.

profile.summary: Alameda Health System is an integrated public health care system in Alameda County, California. It runs five hospitals and four wellness centers, including Highland Hospital in Oakland. It began in 1864 as the Alameda County Infirmary and is governed as a public hospital authority.

sources.title: Calling all Oakland high schoolers: Apply for Alameda Health System's health care internship program. - Alameda Health System

review.notes: AHS is the Alameda County public hospital authority; its own site says its internship serves OUSD students, and a student health MOU fits. Summary and phone (General Inquiries 510-437-4800) are supported by the About, Contact and Wikipedia pages, but 1411 East 31st St is listed there only as Highland Hospital, not as AHS headquarters or a general address.
